Hey filmy, theatrey, comedy, improvy, dancey, musically, artsy, photography, videography, writery, televisiony, industrialy, voice overy, productiony, investory, small businessy, or just curiousy friends!!!

Next Saturday the CFVA (Colorado Film & Video Association) is hosting it’s annual Town Hall event and I HIGHLY encourage you to come. There will be satellite events all over the state, so if you are not in Denver, don’t worry. You are not left out! 

This year we are focusing on creating connections and a more cohesive community. A community for all and we want to hear YOUR voice. We want you to be a big part of the discussion. Your ideas and thoughts matter. So come and share them! 

If you have not been to a Town Hall before, this is a different event than a schmoozer. At the Town Hall, we actually discuss the trajectory of our industry and how to make it better - in large groups and in small break out groups. It’s where we get things done and when intentions get set.

Here are the details. I genuinely hope you attend and help make our community better, stronger and more undeniable! 

RSVP for your region
Saturday, November 14
Join us for the third Film and Media Town Hall now run by the CFVA.

This is the continuation of a series of community-led events aimed to foster statewide collaboration among creatives and media professionals.This state-wide event will take place simultaneously in EIGHT CITIES ACROSS OUR STATE and with an online virtual option for those of you traveling or unable to make one of the locations.

Our goal? To unite our community to grow a strong, thriving film and media industry in Colorado.

The topic? Community Connections - how do we break down the silos

Please RSVP below, so we know how many people will attend each location.

This event is free for everyone to attend thanks to our generous group of volunteers and sponsors: The CFVA, OEDIT CO Office of Film, Television and Media, The City of Lakewood, Mass FX Media, and LoCo+.

RSVP for Your City

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc8n42tusi4gHoWKB0KhLsHXC-EoPZfOYgkfNyJXg15zssZdg/viewform](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc8n42tusi4gHoWKB0KhLsHXC-EoPZfOYgkfNyJXg15zssZdg/viewform)

CASTING CALL:
We are looking for 1 older Black female actress who can do a Nigerian accent and 1 young Black actress who presents masc. We are casting for 2 world premiere plays that are written by 2 local playwrights in the Denver metro area. Performances are December 12 & 13. Rehearsals expected to begin in November. 

The Phase: A lesbian couple from two different cultures must slap on happy faces to prove to their traditional mothers that their gay love is not just a phase. {Casting for an older Black actress to do a Nigerian accent.}

We Need to Talk: A Lesbian Fever Dream: Newly almost u-hauling lesbians Mina and Blessing have some things to talk about before they move in. But they are so blinded by the intensity that they don’t stop to question if it’s really love. Mina falls into a fever dream that helps her work through what’s blocking their communication. {Casting for a young Black actress to present masc}.

At this time this is unpaid, but we aspire to provide compensation if profit has been made from ticket sales. Please fill out this this form: https://forms.gle/PntywLtLWTjmP1JX8 or email moodytingsllc@gmail.com to be considered. Thank you!

CASTING CALL FOR AUDIO DRAMA 

TITLE: The Haunted Man: A Charles Dickens Christmas Story

GENRE: Drama

LOGLINE: A professor of chemistry at a school in 19th century England is haunted by a phantom and the memories of his past leading him to infect those around him with his curse and learn his own valuable lesson about forgiveness and compassion. 

ROLES: (American or British Accents)

**Redlaw/Phantom:** (60’s) An older chemistry professor who is affable and kindly but gets lost in his own pain. Also plays Redlaw’s Phantom

**Narrator:** An older, wisened voice,  Introduction, Outro and a few transitions

**Milly Swidger:** (40’s-50’s) The anecdote to Redlaw’s curse, sweet, compassionate, loving, humble

**William Swidger:** (40’s-50’s) Super talkative keeper of the school grounds, Milly’s husband

**Philip Swidger:** (80’s) William’s Dad who values every memory including the bad ones

**Johnny Tetterby/Wild Boy:** (8-12) A young boy, in charge of caring for his baby sister, well’ behaved but tried. The Wild boy is a juxtaposition of a boy raised wild and never knowing compassion and love.

**Adolphus Tetterby:** (30’s - 40’s) Johnny’s father, a struggling newspaper salesman, calm and level-headed until he’s not.

**Sophia  Tetterby:** (30’s - 40’s) Johnny’s mother, an overworked housewife, wishing she could spurge more this holiday season

**Edmund: **(18 - mid-20’s) The son of Redlaw’s former lover and betraying friend, lies ill and is cared for by Milly

**Longford:** (60’s) Redlaw’s betraying friend who stole his love and then gambled away his life, abandoning his wife and Edmund

**George:** (40’s-50’s) Philip Swidger’s other son who fell into bad company and is currently close to death

**Little Tetterby #1, 2 & 3:** (2-6) Some of the many Tetterby children causing commotion and chaos in the house.

PRODUCTION COMPANY: Storybook Creative

DIRECTOR: Austin Anderson

PRODUCTION TYPE: AUDIO DRAMA

CONTACT: Austin@storybookcreative.co

RUN TIME: ~100 minutes

COMPENSATION: Unpaid

UNION STATUS: Non-Union

AUDITION INFORMATION: Self Tape or in-person

SHOOT DATES: 1-2 shoot days, aiming for the weekend of November 14th and 15th. 

Cheers!

CASTING CALL

LOOKING FOR A MALE ACTOR WHO CAN PLAY 30-40S MAN. 

Casting one role for Palm Stone, a nonunion student short film by Tafari Lewis.

A dedicated therapist keeps herself occupied with work and household routines as her clients’ stories begin to challenge her avoidance of her own grief.

SHOOT DETAILS

November 13-14 2026 • Bel Air, Maryland
Three-day production, actor only needed for two.

COMPENSATION

Unpaid. Meals, screen credit, and footage for acting reels will be provided. 

ROLE

JACK - Supporting, man, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

Jennifer’s husband. Warm, playful, and loves baseball, Jack brings familiar teasing and easy affection to their relationship.

Seeking natural chemistry with Jennifer. The role includes potential hugging and cuddling; no kissing or nudity. 

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your headshot, résumé, acting reel, and availability for November 13–15 through the Google Form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSds4RfIUGX6G-V-l5qk9cZuDP1EIjcq7vwU8bUENdIzPAuSYw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=100122457934176448465

Selected applicants will be invited to submit self-tape auditions.

**TITLE & TYPE:** Livestream – Mock Job Interview Scene
**CASTING:** Actor/Actress, 25+, to portray a professional job interviewer
**LOCATION:** Porter Ranch, Los Angeles, CA, USA
**COMPENSATION:** Paid – $100 flat for approximately 1 hour
**CONTACT:** bradmarschke@gmail.com
**TIME(s):** Wednesday, November 11, 2026 – ~3PM PST.

We're looking for someone to play the role of a job interviewer for a livestream production tomorrow in the Porter Ranch area.

You'll be conducting a mock job interview on camera. The role will involve asking interview questions, reacting naturally to responses, and improvising throughout the segment.

Looking for someone who can convincingly portray a professional interviewer, is comfortable on camera, and has strong improvisational skills.

**To apply:** Please email a brief introduction, headshot or recent photo, and any relevant acting experience. Must be available tomorrow for approximately one hour. Commenting below, and private messages on Facebook are also acceptable.

items.text:
SZUKAMY MODELKI 60+
Jesteśmy studentkami Uniwersytetu Wrocławskiego i realizujemy projekt społeczny w ramach jednego z naszych zaliczeń. Projekt polega na stworzeniu koncepcji marki perfum wraz z kampanią, której głównym tematem są dojrzałe kobiety i przełamywanie stereotypów związanych ze starością. 

Chcemy pokazać, że wraz z wiekiem kobiety nie tracą swojej tożsamości. Wręcz przeciwnie, stają się bardziej świadome siebie, pewniejsze i silniejsze. Nasza kampania ma podkreślać, że starość nie jest wyrokiem ani końcem kobiecości, ale naturalnym etapem życia, który niesie ze sobą doświadczenie, charakter i autentyczność. 

Szukamy dojrzałej, otwartej i pewnej siebie kobiety, która będzie potrafiła przekazać wartości naszej kampanii. Jeśli masz partnera/partnerkę z którą chciałabyś zapozować, zapraszamy.

Dodajemy też zdjęcia, które stanowią dla nas inspirację i pomagają oddać klimat całej kampanii. 

Osoby zainteresowane udziałem, zapraszamy do kontaktu przez wiadomości prywatne lub do pozostawienia komentarza. Ponieważ jest to projekt studencki, realizujemy go na zasadach non-profit:)

items.text:
🎬 Szukamy dziewczyn 18–25 lat do nagrania wideo – już w środę 11.11!
Szukamy dziewczyn, które chciałyby wystąpić w materiale w formule randkowej. Wcielisz się w rolę uczestniczki randki z jednym z naszych głównych twórców internetowych, a gotowy film trafi na kanał na YouTube. 💬

Kogo szukamy?

✨ dziewczyn w wieku 18–25 lat

✨ z jakimkolwiek doświadczeniem aktorskim (każde się liczy!)

✨ swobodnych przed kamerą, otwartych i z naturalną energią

Szczegóły:

📅 środa, 11 listopada

📍 Mikołów (okolice Katowic)

🕒 start ok. 15:00 do ok. 16:00

💸 Stawka: to Ty proponujesz swoje oczekiwania finansowe, my się do nich odniesiemy.

Jak się zgłosić?

Napisz do mnie prywatnie i podeślij:

• imię, nazwisko i wiek

• m link do social mediów

• mile widziały krótki filmik (kilka zdań o sobie)

• swoją propozycję stawki

• potwierdzenie, że jesteś dostępna 11 listopada

Stagebugz Theatre is seeking performers and groups of all kinds for our winter variety show on December 3rd! 

For the actors in the group: scenes, comedy routines, strong monologues, improv performances are all welcome! 

Auditions are November 15th at Columbine Library, or via self-tape. Sign up at this link: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADAF22A7F5C52-65823774-tricks#/ 

Or email stagebugztheatre@gmail.com for self tape instructions.

This is a volunteer opportunity; however all performers are invited to a post-show reception with lots of food and prizes!

Stagebugz Theatre is a 501(c)3 non-profit dedicated to making arts education more accessible to youth in our community. To learn more about us, visit www.stagebugztheatre.com/

Inclusive modeling agencies for plus size kids
Does anyone know of any reputable NY/NJ modeling/talent agencies that are inclusive of larger bodies? My kids (12 & 10) are extremely photogenic with great personalities but it’s hard to find an agency interested in representing your not-so-typical body type. Any info would be great! Thanks!!

topComments.text:
Every agency in NYC we have seen husky/plus .   There are multiple brands that utilize talent with that body structure.  
However if they are above a certain height they are considered "sized out" no matter the age size.
When I self submit for my son I see heavier set kid breakdowns often 👍🏽 there’s def a spot for them! Goodluck ✨

Okay, y'all,  Stephen and I made a SERIES. 🛋️😂
It's called Store 602 a furniture store comedy mockumentary. Prison-built furniture. A staff serving a life sentence of retail. And Big Grizz running the store like his own little kingdom. Corporate wants a polished success story… the employees have other priorities. The cameras catch the difference. 😂

We're raising funds to shoot the pilot and build toward a six-episode first season starting with the store's first Big Grizz Day.

Our Kickstarter is LIVE, and every backer, every share, every prayer over this project truly counts. We're believing God for good things and for this story to make people laugh.

👉 Back it here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/store-602/store-602-a-furniture-store-comedy-mockumentary

Pledges start at just $10 that's the Clock In reward, with an exclusive wallpaper and $25 gets you your own personalized Store 602 employee badge.

If you can't back it right now, a share is just as powerful. Tag someone who would love this!
Thank you for showing up for us. Let's go! ✨

#Store602 #SupportIndieFilm #ComedyMockumentary #EvettesWakeUpCall

🎭 CASTING DO SPEKTAKLU MUZYCZNEGO „CZASOPRZESTRZENIE” 🕰️✨
(Projekt niekomercyjny / Non-profit)
Masz 16–35 lat? Twoją pasją jest muzyka, taniec lub aktorstwo i szukasz miejsca, w którym możesz dać z siebie wszystko? To idealny moment! Organizujemy casting do nowej produkcji. 🧡

🔍 KOGO SZUKAMY?
Zależy nam na osobach, które:
 Są mocno zaangażowane i gotowe na intensywną pracę,
 Nie boją się wyzwań i odnajdują się w działaniu pod presją czasu,
 Są otwarte, kreatywne i grają zespołowo.
Doświadczenie aktorskie/wokalne/taneczne mile widziane. 

SPIS POSTACI:
Role główne:
ZEGARMISTRZ - energiczny, przebojowy, to on sprawuje pieczę nad miastem i dziejącymi się w nim wydarzeniami. Skrywa w sobie tajemnicę. Mężczyzna w wieku 16 - 35 lat. Wymagana umiejętność śpiewu. Mile widziane doświadczenie taneczne. 

HUGO - młody, ambitny, zabiegany, zagubiony. Główny bohater całej historii, próbuje odnaleźć się w pośpiechu świata. Chłopak w wieku 16 - 25? lat. Umiejętność śpiewu wymagana, doświadczenie taneczne mile widziane.

BELLADONNA - stanowcza, silna, władcza. Czarny charakter w miasteczku. Umiejętność śpiewu wymagana, doświadczenie taneczne mile widziane. Kobieta w wieku 16 - 35 lat.

BOB - dobry duch i wsparcie dla każdego w miasteczku. Nikt nie wiem kim do końca jest i z kim się wziął ale zawsze można na niego liczyć w trudnej chwili. Zabawny, wesoły, wyluzowany, pełny światła. Mężczyzna w wieku 16-35 lat.

BABCIA - Babcia Huga, spokojna, dobra, pełna miłości, spokoju, ma najczystsze serce na świecie. Kobieta 16 - 35 lat.

Role drugoplanowe:
Doświadczenie wokalne i taneczne mile widziane. 
WETERYNARZ- Mężczyzna 16 - 25 lat
STEWARD - Mężczyzna 16 - 25 lat
PIELĘGNIARKA- Kobieta 16 - 25 lat
NAUCZYCIELKA - Kobieta 16-25 lat

📅 JAK WYGLĄDA CASTING?
Casting składa się z dwóch etapów:
1. I etap (online) – na podstawie nadesłanych zgłoszeń.
2. II etap (stacjonarny) – odbędzie się w Gdańsku 15.11.

🚨 BARDZO WAŻNE – HARMONOGRAM PRÓB I PREMIERA
Zanim wyślisz zgłoszenie, upewnij się, że możesz wziąć udział w próbach w Trójmieście. Przewidujemy, że praca będzie szła na tyle sprawnie, że zmniejszymy ilość prób i godzin;)) W rozpisce są dwa możliwe terminy setów spektaklowych - jesteśmy w trakcie ustalania szczegółów. 
Listopad 2026
 15.11 nd – 10:00–20:00  CASTING

Grudzień 2026

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Wyślij maila na adres: przedostatniprzystanek@gmail.com
W tytule umieść:
        1. Imię, nazwisko
        2. napis CASTING
        3. Nazwa postaci, która cię interesuje. (W mailu napisz również czy zgadzasz się na obsadzenie cię w innej postaci.)
przykład: Anna Kowalska, CASTING, Belladonna
W wiadomości umieść:
1. Krótki opis swojej osoby oraz aktualne zdjęcia (portret + sylwetka).
2. Opis dotychczasowego doświadczenia (CV; jeśli masz selftape – koniecznie podlinkuj, bardzo mile widziany! - link do prywatnego filmu na yt😊).
3. Link do swojego profilu na Facebooku / Messengerze. 

⏰ Czas ucieka! Na zgłoszenia czekamy do 12 listopada włącznie.
Do osób zakwalifikowanych do II etapu odezwiemy się drogą mailową.
Czujesz, że to coś dla Ciebie? Nie zwlekaj, zgłoś się i tworzymy coś razem! 🌟
Jeśli twoja osoba różni się od wymaganych opisów - próbuj! Może stworzysz nowe oblicze tej postaci;))

🎬 Introducing Kino Klub – a film discussion club by Film Society Denmark

Let's talk movies! Kino Klub is our new weekly film discussion club, hosted at Vester Vov Vov Cinema.

Every Sunday, we get together to talk movies & TV shows, share recommendations and discover films from all over the world. 
Kino Klub is like a book club, but for movies and TV shows. 

Open to everyone! Free entry, registration required. 

Snacks and beverages will be available to buy at the café.

Spots are limited, so register soon via the ticket link!

**Role:** Funeral Attendees (Background / Extras)
**Shoot Date:** Friday, November 13, 2026

**Location:** Knox United Church – 5590 Balaclava St, Vancouver, BC
**Compensation:** Volunteer / Unpaid (Full lunch, snacks, and refreshments provided!)

* **35 to 40 Background Actors**
* **Ages:** All ages welcome (18 to 80+)

**Wardrobe Requirement:**

Please email sarah.walsh@vanhorrorstudios.ca the subject line: **[SLEEPING DOGS EXTRA - Your Name] or msg me on FB.**
Include the following in your email:

1. Your full name, age, and phone number.
2. Confirmation that you are fully available for a 7:00 AM call time on Friday, Nov 13.

Thanks and hope to see you on set!

items.text:
LOOKING FOR BACKGROUND
Hello everyone! 

Im Alice, the producer of Closing Costs, one of the finals  from Vancouver Film School. 

We are currently looking for male background actors for some of the shootings in the office! 

This offer is volunteer, since we are a low budget production. There will be crafty in site. 

The background has a big part on our movie since we have plans to choreograph a big scene because we want to represent a lack of humanity by having every single person making the same movements: typing, calling, stretching, etc.

If you’re interested please send us an email to sales.team.six.productions@gmail.com* with your headshot and resume! 

Thank you!

🎅🎄 SANTA CLAUS & CHRISTMAS ELVES WANTED – DECEMBER 2026! 🎄🎅
✨ Enchanted Adventures – Himley Hall Christmas Light Trail ✨

We’re looking for fantastic, professional Santas and enthusiastic Christmas elves to join our team and help create a truly magical festive experience for families this Christmas!

We pride ourselves on delivering a high-standard, immersive Christmas experience, so we’re looking for performers who can bring our festive characters to life with warmth, energy, enthusiasm and exceptional attention to detail.

📍 Location: Himley Hall, Dudley, West Midlands, DY3 4DF

📅 Dates required:

🎄 Thursday 3rd – Sunday 6th December

🎄 Thursday 10th – Sunday 13th December

🎄 Thursday 17th – Thursday 24th December

16 event days in total.

⏰ Advertised event times: 4:00pm–8:30pm

Exact working hours, including preparation and any later finishes, will be confirmed.

🎅 SANTA CLAUS

We’re seeking an experienced, authentic and engaging Father Christmas who can deliver a truly memorable grotto experience.

You must be confident interacting with children and families, staying in character and maintaining an exceptional standard throughout each session.

🧝 CHRISTMAS ELVES

We’re also recruiting friendly, energetic and engaging elves to welcome families, create festive excitement, assist with the Santa experience and keep the Christmas magic alive!

Previous performance or character experience would be advantageous.

⭐ WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

✅ Professional, reliable and punctual performers

✅ Excellent communication and interaction skills

✅ A natural ability to engage with children and families

✅ High standards of presentation and character performance

✅ A positive attitude and plenty of festive enthusiasm

✅ Availability for all or most of the event dates

Ideally, we’d love performers who can commit to the full 16-day run, although we’ll also consider applicants with partial availability.

💷 Paid positions – rates to be discussed.

📩 INTERESTED?

Please send us a private message with:

🎅 The role you’re interested in (Santa or Elf)

📅 Your availability across the dates

🎭 Any relevant experience

📸 Photos of previous character work, if available

💷 Your rates

🎄 Please share or tag anyone who would be perfect for these roles!

Help us make Christmas 2026 truly magical at Himley Hall! ✨

#SantaWanted #ChristmasElves #ChristmasJobs #HimleyHall #EnchantedAdventures #Dudley #WestMidlands #Christmas2026

items.text:
**Casting a young (14-18) hispanic actress **to play ‘Young Sierra’ in Level Up, a Project DU F.I.L.M. production and an episode of the ‘Womanhood’ series.

**Logline:** When a self-doubting female gamer with an invisible disability, is called upon for a game design instructor teaching demo, she must defeat the demons in her mind to prove her worth.

**Character Description:**

**Young Sierra [Female] [Hispanic] [Dark Brown Hair] [Brown Eyes] [Age 14-18]**

Young Sierra has a secret: she loves playing games. It might not seem like a big secret to many, but she’s learned not to tell anyone. All the adversity she’s faced in the gaming space led to her creating a new gamer tag, ‘Cyrus’, so no boys will bully her for being a girl gamer. Make no mistake, she’ll never let anyone take gaming away from her and the bullying has only made her more determined to make an impact on the gaming space when she grows up.

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Minor roles: $50/day. Needed for 1 day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Shooting Information:** Filming in the University of Denver and surrounding neighborhood during December 13-15.

**Audition Information:** Please send your headshot and resume to *levelupproduction2026@gmail.com*. You will receive a side and more information after.

topComments.text: Hi just confirming you’re looking for darker Hispanic skin and hair, rather than light skinned??

🎬 CASTING DO TELEDYSKU RAPOWEGO | Bielsko-Biała, 12.11 lub 13.11 (któryś z tych dni - jeden dzień zdjęciowy)

POSZUKUJĘ:

STATYŚCI, 18-30 lat: 100 zł gotówką od razu po planie
Energia, żywioł, blokowe klimaty. Domówka rodem z blokowiska albo scena przy starym aucie pod blokiem.

Tytuł maila: STATYŚCI KLIP 12.11-13.11

STATYŚCI, 30–50 lat: 100 zł netto gotówką od razu po planie
Imieniny u szalonej ciotki: schludnie przy stole, ale z luzem.
Tytuł maila: STATYŚCI URODZINY CIOTKI 12.11-13.11

EPIZODYŚCI, 40–60 lat: 500 zł netto płatne po planie
Charyzmatyczni szaleni wujkowie rodem z PRL na imieninach u ciotki.
Tytuł maila: EPIZODYSTA KLIP 12.11-13.11

W zgłoszeniu: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki bez filtrów. Epizodyści dodatkowo link do wizytówki na YouTube.

කථාවේ සැබෑ ස්වභාවයට න්‍යායන්ගෙන් බාධා නොකර සිටි චිත්‍රපටයක්.
##################################

මේ පළමු මාතෘකාව මං ලියන්නෙ The Shawshank Redemption චිත්‍රපටයෙ ප්‍රධාන භූමිකා දෙකෙන් එකක් නිරූපණය කළ ටිම් රොබින්ස් (Tim Robbins)එක්තරා සම්මුඛ සාකච්ඡාවකට කියපු දෙයක සාරය අරගෙන. 
සමහර විට මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ කතාව අනුව ප්‍රේක්ෂකයා අවුස්සමින්, වහා ම වැඩි නැරඹුම් වාර ගණනාවක් ලෝක ප්‍රේක්ෂකයින්ගෙන් ලබාගතහැකිව තිබූ නිර්මාණයක්. 
ඒත්, මෙහි අධ්‍යක්ෂ ෆ්‍රෑන්ක් ඩැරබොන්ට්(Frank Darrabont)  කියා තිබෙනවා, මෙහි අනෙක් ප්‍රධාන නළුවා වන මෝගන් ෆ්‍රීමන් (Morgan Freeman)ගේ  වඩාත් ම චිත්තවේගී(emotional), හැඟුම්බර ම දර්ශනය පවා හිතාමතාම චිත්‍රපටයෙන් ඉවත් කළ බව. එයට හේතුව වුණේ එම රංගනය අති විශිෂ්ට වුණත්, යට කී ලෙස චිත්‍රපටයේ ස්වභාවයට ඒක බාධාවක් යැයි හැඟීම බව ඔහු කියනවා. ඒක චිත්‍රපට නිර්මාණයට උනන්දු වන අපට අතිශය වැදගත් පාඩමක්. 

පස්සෙ කාලෙක මේ නිර්මාණය ම මිලියන ගණනක මිනිසුන්ගේ ජීවිතවලට මහ බලාපොරොත්තුවක් එකතු කරේ කොහොම ද? ජීවිත මිලියන ගණන් වෙනස්  කරේ කොහොම ද? ඒ ඇයි?..
මේ ප්‍රශ්න වලට උත්තර චිත්‍රපටි භාෂාවෙන් ම හොයන්ඩ මට හිතුණා.
ඒ උත්තර මේ විදිහට බෙදාගමු. 

බලාපොරොත්තුව(Hope) සහ ආයතනගතව(Institutionalized) හිරවීම, හැප්පෙන ලස්සන
##############################

හිරගෙයක දිගු කාලයක් හිර වී සිටී ම කියන එක අප හොඳින්  දැකල අහල
තියනවා. ඒක පැහැදිලියි. ඒත්, එහෙම ඇතුළෙ හිටියා හෝ නැතා අපට මානසික හිරගෙවල් වල හිර වී ඉන්නට සිද්ධ වෙලා තියන විදිහ අතිශය කණගාටුදායකයි. සමාජයීය, සංස්කෘතික, දේශපාලන වගේ හැම අතින් ම ඔබටත් මටත් ඒ හිරවීම බලපා තිබෙන බව ඇත්තක්.

හැබැයි ඒ හිරවීම් වලින් නිදහස් වෙන්ඩ බැරි ද?
අත්නොහරින බලාපොරොත්තුවක් පසුපස එන  අධිෂ්ඨානය සහ ඒ සඳහා නිහඬව ම කාලයක් පුරා ක්‍රියාකිරීම කොහොම ද ජයග්‍රාහී නිදහසට බලපාන්නේ, කියන අදහස ඉතා විශිෂ්ට අයුරින් නිර්මාණයකට ගොනු වුණ අවස්ථාවක් තමයි The Shawshank Redemption.

කථාව ගැටගහන, අපූරු  
මිත්‍රත්වයේ ලණුව.  
##################

The Shawshank Redemption චිත්‍රපටයේ කථා වස්තුව ගෙතෙන්නේ තමන් නොකළ වරදකට ජීවිතාන්තය දක්වා සිරදඬුවම් විඳීන්නට සිදුවන බැංකුකරුවෙක් වටායි.

කථාවේ ප්‍රධාන සිදුවීම් පෙළගැස්ම තුළ අසාධාරණ ම  සිරදඬුවමක් තියෙනවා. ටිම් රොබින්ස් රගන චරිතය වන ඇන්ඩි ඩුෆ්‍රේන් (Andy Dufresne) නම් තරුණ බැංකුකාරයට, ඔහුගේ බිරිඳ සහ ඇගේ අනියම් සැමියා ඝාතනය කිරීමේ ව්‍යාජ චෝදනාව මත "ෂෝෂෑන්ක්" (Shawshank) නැමැති බය හිතෙන හිරගෙදරට ඇතුළත් වෙන්නට සිදු වෙනව.
හිරගෙදර තුළදී ඇන්ඩිට, එහි ඉන්න ඕනෑම බාහිර භාණ්ඩයක් හොරෙන් ඇතුළට ගෙන්වා, සිරකරුවන්ට දීමේ බලවත් සබඳතා ජාලයක් සහිත සිරකරුවෙක් හමුවෙනවා. ඒ තමයි රෙඩ් (Red). එ  චරිතයට පණ දෙන්නේ මෝගන් ෆ්‍රීමන්(MORGAN Freeman) කියන අති දක්ෂ නළුවා. මේ දෙන්නා  අතර දැඩි මිත්‍රත්වයක් ඇති වෙනව.
ඇන්ඩි තමන් සතු බැංකු හා මූල්‍ය දැනුම භාවිතා කරමින්, හිරගෙදර දූෂිත නිලධාරීන්ගේ සහ එහි ප්‍රධාන ජේලර්වරයාගේ බදු මුදල් වංචා ක්‍රමවත්ව සකස් කර දෙමින් ඔවුන්ගේ විශ්වාසය දිනා ගන්නවා.
 අවුරුදු  20 ක කාලයක් අප්‍රමාණ තාඩන පීඩන මධ්‍යයේ වුණත්, ඇන්ඩි තමන්ගෙ නිදහස පිළිබඳ බලාපොරොත්තුව කිසිවිටෙක අත් හරින්නෙ නැහැ.
කෙසේ වෙතත්, මෙහි නොසිතූ අවසානයක් සනිටුහන් වෙනවා. අවසානයේදී ඇන්ඩි කවුරුවත් ම බලාපොරොත්තු නොවන අතිශය සූක්ෂ්ම හා විස්මිත ක්‍රමයකින් හිරගෙයින් පැනල යනවා. ඒ විතරක් නෙමයි, ඔහු මේ හිරගෙදර දූෂිත නිලධාරීන්වත් සියලු සාක්ෂි සහිතව නීතියට කොටු කරල දෙනවා. 

සිනමා භාෂාවට (Film Language) යා හැකි දුර සහ බර ලකුණු කළ The Shawshank Redemption
####################################

 මෙම චිත්‍රපටයේ  තිර රචනය (Screenplay) සහ අධ්‍යක්ෂණය ෆ්‍රෑන්ක් ඩැරබොන්ට් (Frank Darabont) විසින් තමයි සිද්ධ වු⁣ණේ. රෙඩ් ගේ පසුබිම් හඬ ප්‍රකාශනයක් (Voice-over Narration) මඟින් ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාව මේ හිරගෙදර ඇතුළාන්තයටම අරගෙන යන ගමන්, උපහාසය, වේදනාව සහ දර්ශනය එකට කැටි වූ විශිෂ්ට දෙබස් මාලාවක් ගේනවා. ඒ දෙක ම යට  කී අපූරු මිත්‍රත්වයේ සුවඳ විහිදුවන විදිහ මේ නිර්මාණයට ම ආවේණිකයි.

මෙහි කැමරාකරණය (Cinematography) ප්‍රවීණ කැමරා ශිල්පී රොජර් ඩීකින්ස් (Roger Deakins)ගෙ අමතක නොවන වැඩක්.  හිරගෙදර ඇති හුදෙකලාව සහ පීඩනය පෙන්වන  නිශ්චල සහ සීමිත රාමු  (Static & Enclosed Frames) වැඩේට  අතිශය ආදාළයි. ඇන්ඩි හිරගෙයින් පැන යන අවස්ථාවේ දී භාවිත කරන, අහසේ සිට ගන්නා පුළුල් දර්ශන(Wide-angle Aerial Shots) මඟින් සැබෑ නිදහසේ හැඟීම සිනමාත්මකව තීව්‍ර කරනවා.

රංගනය (Acting) පැත්තෙන් ගත්තහම ටිම් රොබින්ස් (Andy) ගේ නිශ්ශබ්ද, ඉවසිලිවන්ත බව සහ මෝගන් ෆ්‍රීමේන් (Red) ගේ ස්වාභාවික, පැසුණු රංගනය චිත්‍රපටයේ ජීවය කිව්වත් හරි. ඔවුන්ගේ ඇස්වලින් සහ ශරීර භාෂාවෙන් (Body Language) ප්‍රකාශ කරන හැඟීම්, වචනවලට වඩා අතිශය බලවත්. හැම ශිල්පියාම පාහේ නිර්මාණයට බැඳුණු ආවේණික වූ විවිධත්වයකින් කම තම  වැඩේ ඉන්නවා. 
 මෙහි රංගනයේ දී ශරීර භාෂාව (Body Language) ගැන සළකා බැලුව හොත්, ඇන්ඩිගේ මුහුණේ ඉරියව් (Facial Expressions)  අතිශය වැදගත්. ඔහු කතා කරන්නේ ඉතාමත් සන්සුන්, නමුත් දැඩි අධිෂ්ඨානශීලී ස්වරයක් තිබෙන අතර  ඔහුගේ ඇස් තුළ බලාපොරොත්තුව සහ පැහැදිලි සැලසුමක් ඇති බව පේනවා.
රෙඩ් දෙසට හැරුණොත් ඔහුගේ රංගනයේ දී ප්‍රතිචාරය (Reaction)  වැදගත්. ඒ මුහුණෙන් පෙනෙන්නේ එක්වරම බාහිරෙන් නොපෙනෙන  අභ්‍යන්තර බිය සහ අසරණභාවයයි. මෙතිනන් ගැළවී යාම සිහිනයක් යන මතයයි. ඇන්ඩි සිරගෙයින් පැන යාමට සිතනවා විය හැකි යැයි රෙඩ් තුළ ඇති වන සැකය සහ මිතුරා කෙරෙහි ඇති බිය ඔහුගේ වෙව්ලන ශරීර භාෂාවෙන් මැනවින් නිරූපණය වෙනවා.

ආලෝකකරණය (Lighting) පැත්තෙන් සුවිශේෂී බවකුත් මෙහි තිබෙනවා. සිරගෙය තුළ පවතින අඳුරු, අළු සහ නිල් පැහැති (Cold, Low-key Lighting) මඟින් බලාපොරොත්තු විරහිත බව පෙන්වනවා. නමුත් ඇන්ඩි පුස්තකාලය තුළ ඉන්න විට හෝ සිරකරුවන්ට බියර් දෙන අවස්ථාවල දී  උණුසුම්, රන්වන් ආලෝකය(Warm, Golden Lighting) භාවිත කරමින් බලාපොරොත්තුව සහ මානුෂීය බව ඉස්මතු කරන විදිහ ටිකක් අවධානයෙන් බලන්ඩ කියල ප්‍රේක්ෂකයන්ට මං යෝජනා කරනව. (පොදුවේ චිත්‍රපටය පුරා වර්ණ ගෙන එන්නෙත් එවන් ගැඹුරු අර්ථයකින් බව ලගපැහැදිලිවම පේනවා.)
ඒ වගේ ම අවසන් දර්ශනයේ දී ඇන්ඩි සහ රෙඩ් ගේ මුහුණු මතට ආලෝකය වැටෙන්නේ තරමක් සැර, ස්වභාවික සූර්යාලෝකයක්. එයින් ඔවුන්ගේ ජීවිතවල ඇති රළු යථාර්ථයත්, ඒ සමඟම ඇන්ඩි කථා කරන "Zihuatanejo" (පැසිෆික් වෙරළ තීරය) නැමැති නිදහස් ලෝකයේ ආලෝකයත් වක්‍රව ඉඟි කරනවා.

මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ සංගීතය(Music/Score) තෝමස් නිව්මන්  (Thomas Newman) විසින් කරන ලද අපූරු කාර්යයක්.  චිත්‍රපටයට නැවුම් ආත්මයක් ලබා දෙන්නෙ මේ අංශයෙන්. හිරගෙදර පීඩනය දනවන්නට මන්දගාමී අවම පියානෝ ඛණ්ඩ (Minimalist Piano Notes) භාවිත කරන ඔහු, නිදහස සහ සහනය පෙන්වන් තැන් වල ප්‍රබල වාද්‍ය වෘන්ද සංගීතය (Symphonic Swells) භාවිත කරන විදිහ සාවධානව බලන කෙනෙකුට පේනවා, ඇහෙනවා.

රිචඩ් ෆ්‍රැන්සිස්-බෲස් (Richard Francis-Bruce) අතින්  මෙහි සංස්කරණය (Editing) සිද්ධ වෙනවා. ඔහු කාලය ගලායාම ඉතා සුමටව හසුරුවන ගමන් වසර 20ක සිරගෙදර ජීවිතය ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාට වෙහෙසක් නොදැනෙන ලෙස සිනමාත්මකව ගේනවා. ඒකට ඔහු  සූක්ෂමව රූප දියකර රූප මතුකිරීම් සහ(Dissolves) සහ සමාන රූප කැපුම්, ගැළපුම්(Match Cuts) වැනි සංස්කරණ උපක්‍රම යොදාගන්න විදිහ ප්‍රශංසනීයයි.
වේගය සහ රිද්මය(Pacing, Tempo & Flow) චිත්‍රපටයේ ගලායාම (Flow) අරගෙන බැලුවත්, සිරගෙදර ජීවිතය මෙන් මන්දගාමී, ස්ථාවර රිද්මයකින් (Slow, Deliberate Tempo) ඇරඹෙන එකක්. කථා වස්තුව ඉදිරියට යත්ම, විශේෂයෙන්ම අවසාන භාගයේ ඇන්ඩිගේ පලායාම දිග හැරෙනකොට, මෙහි වේගය (Pacing) වැඩි වෙන අතර එය ප්‍රේක්ෂකයා කුතුහලයේ උපරිමයට (Climax) අරගෙන යනව.

සමාජවිද්‍යාත්මක වියමන යටින් මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක ගැඹුරට 
########################

මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ සමාජ විද්‍යාව (Sociology) විශේෂ එකක්. හිරගෙය කියන්නෙ සමාජයේම කුඩා ආකෘතියක් (Microcosm).
 මෙහි දී බාහිර සමාජයෙන් වෙන් වෙලා වෙන ම සමාජයක ඉන්න  සිරකරුවන්, තමන්ට ම ආවේණික වූ සමාජ ධුරාවලියක් වගේ ම නීති පද්ධතියක් සහ උප සංස්කෘතියක් (Subculture) ගොඩනගා ගන්න විදිහ පැහැදිලිව පෙන්වනවා. රෙඩ් වැනි සිරකරුවන් හරහා ගොඩනැගෙන මිත්‍රත්වය සහ සහයෝගීතාවය වෙනස් ම කතාවක් කියනවා. කොයිතරම් කර්කශ පරිසරයක වුණත්, මිනිසා සමාජයීය සත්වයෙකු ලෙස අන්‍යොන්‍ය සබඳතා මත යැපෙන බව හරි අපූරුවට කියන චිත්‍රපටයක් තමයි Shawshank Redemption. 
 ඒක එහෙම තියෙද්දි, මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක පක්ෂයෙන්  (Psychological Aspect) දෙන අර්ථය වෙනම රහක්. චිත්‍රපටය තුළ ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන්ම කථා කරන්නේ බලාපොරොත්තුව (Hope) සහ ආයතනගත වීම (Institutionalization) අතර ඇති මානසික අරගලය කිව්වොත් නිවැරදියි. වසර ගණනාවක් සිරගෙයක බිත්ති හතරකට කොටු වී සිටින විට, මිනිස්සු එම පරිසරයට කෙතරම් හුරු වෙනවා ද කිව්වොත්, නිදහසට පවා ඔවුන් බයයි.  උදාහරණයක් විදිහට ගත්තොත් බෘෘක්ස්ගේ චරිතය. ඔහු  අවුරුදු 50ක් හිරගෙදර ඉන්න කෙනෙක්. එහි පුස්තකාලයක් තිබෙන අතර එහි ප්‍රධානියා විදිහට පුදුම තරං උනන්දුවෙන් වැඩ කරනවා. ඔහු ඇතුළෙ ලෝකයෙම හිරවෙලා ඉන්න ගමන් කවදාවත් එළියෙ බලාපොරොත්තුවක් නැහැ කියන ස්ථාවරයෙ ඉන්නවා. නමුත් ඇන්ඩිගේ චරිතය පෙන්වා දෙන්නෙ දැඩි මානසික ස්ථාවරත්වයක් සහ බලාපොරොත්තුවක් තුළින් ඕනෑම හිරවීමකින්,  බිඳවැටීමකින් නැගී සිටිය හැකි බවක්.

මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ දෘෂ්ටිවාදය (Ideology) ආගමික සහ නීතිමය පක්ෂයෙන් මතුකර සදය උපහාසයට ලක් කරන විදිහ අපූරුයි. පාලක නොර්ටන්(Norton) "බයිබලය" තම ආයුධය කරගනිමින්, සිරකරුවන් ශික්ෂණය කරන බව අඟවනවා. යථාර්ථයේ දි ඔහු කරන්නේ දෘෂ්ටිවාදයන් ආයුධය කරගෙන තමන්ගේ දූෂිත ව්‍යාපාර වල ජඩකම් වසා ගැනීමයි. එසේ ම නීතිය සැමවිටම සාධාරණ නොවන බව මෙහි පෙන්වනව. සැබෑ සාධාරණත්වය සහ නිදහස උදාකරගත යුත්තේ පද්ධතියට අභියෝග කිරීමෙන් (Rebellion) බව මෙහි තවත් මූලික දෘෂ්ටිවාදී ලක්ෂණයක්.
මෙකී තත්වය දේශපාලනිකව(Politically)  යොදාගෙන, පාලන තන්ත්‍රය තම අධිකාරී බලය සහ දූෂණය (Authoritarianism and Corruption) යහමින් කරනවා. සිරගෙදර ප්‍රධාන පාලකයා (Warden Norton) ඉතා කූඨ විදිහට ආගමික භක්තිකයෙකු ලෙස රඟපාමින්, තමා සතු දේශපාලනික හා පරිපාලන බලය අනිසි ලෙස ම භාවිතා කරනවා. සිරකරුවන් සූරාකෑම සහ මිනිස් ඝාතන පවා මෙහෙයවන්නෙ අති අමානුෂික විදිහට. එමඟින් මෙම චිත්‍රපටයේ දී, පද්ධතියේ ඇති අසාධාරණත්වය සහ බලය අනිසි ලෙස හැසිරවීම පිළිබඳ දේශපාලනික විවේචනයක් ඉදිරිපත් කෙරෙන බව පේනවා.

පංතිවාදය (Classism) අරගෙන බැලුවත් හිරගෙදර පාලකයින් සහ ආරක්ෂකයින් සැමවිටම සිරකරුවන් දෙස බලන්නේ ඔවුන් පහත්, මනුෂ්‍යත්වයෙන් තොර පිරිසක් විදිහට. ඇන්ඩි උගත්, ඉහළ පංතියේ බැංකුකරුවෙක් වුණත්, හිරගෙය තුළදී ඔහුට ද සාමාන්‍ය පංතියේ සිරකරුවෙකු ලෙස ම දරුණු වධහිංසාවලට ලක්වෙනව. පසුව ඔහුගේ මූල්‍යමය දැනුම (Cultural Capital) නිසා ඔහුට අනෙක් සිරකරුවන්ට වඩා යම් වරප්‍රසාදිත මට්ටමකට පැමිණීමට හැකිවීමෙන්, පංතිමය බලය කොතනත් ක්‍රියාත්මක වන විදිහ සූක්ෂම ව කියන චිත්‍රපටයක් මේ.

ප්‍රේක්ෂක මනස සසල කළ 
The Mozart Scene
####################

 මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ විශේෂ ම තැනක් ලෙස අපට දැනෙනවා Mozart සංගීතය අවස්ථාවෝචිතව  සූක්ෂම අයුරින් යොදාගත් අපූර්ව වූ සුන්දර දර්ශනය. එහි සිනමාත්මක භාවිතය කෙටියෙන් සඳහන් කළොත්;
ඒ, ඇන්ඩි විසින් සිරගෙදර ශබ්දවාහිනී පද්ධතිය ක්‍රියාත්මක කරන මැදිරිය ආක්‍රම්‍ය කරන ලදුව මොසාර්ට්ගේ "Le Nozze di Figaro" ඔපෙරා ගීතය වාදනය කරන අවස්ථාවයි. රෙඩ් පවසන පරිදි, සිරකරුවන්ට එහි වචන නොතේරුණත්, එම ගීතයේ අති සුන්දරත්වය සිරගෙදර බිත්ති බිඳදමා ඔවුන්ට සැබෑ නිදහසේ හැඟීම මොහොතකට හෝ සමීප කරවනවා.
බලහත්කාරයෙන් මෙන් ඇන්ඩි මඟින් චිත්‍රපටයේ කරන මේ ක්‍රියාව ලෝකයේ බොහෝ විචාරකයන්ගෙ විවිධ විග්‍රහයන්ට ලක් වුණා.

සීමා බිඳ දමන කැපවීමක මහත
########################

අවසානයේ දී අසූචි සහ අපද්‍රව්‍ය පිට කරන විශාල නළයක් දිගේ ඇන්ඩි ලෙස හිරගෙදර පරිශ්‍රයෙන් පිටතට විශාල දුරක් යන ටිම් ට මුහුණ දීමට සිදු වූ දරාගත නොහැකි තත්වය වුණේ, අසාමාන්‍ය දුර්ගන්ධය සහ අපහසුතාවයයි. එය අමිහිරිම අත්දැකිමක් බව ඔහු කීවා. කණගාටුදායකම කරුණ වන්නේ ඔහු පසුවයි දැනගන්නේ, එහි තිබූ අප්‍රසන්න පාට ඝන දියරයට ගොම සහ හරක් මුත්‍රා එකතු කර තිබූ බව. 
රසායන ද්‍රව්‍ය දමා ආරක්ෂිත කරතිබුණ ද එය ඉවසීමට නොහැකි දුගඳක් බව ඔහු කියා තිබෙනවා. 
එනිසා ම දර්ශනය අතිශය ස්වභාවික වූ බව අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයා පවසා තිබෙනවා.

"ගැලවීම තිබෙන්නේ බයිබලයේමයි" සිනමාත්මක උත්ප්‍රාසයේ අපූර්වත්වය
####################################

මෙය ඇන්ඩිට සිරගෙදරින් පැන යන්නට උමඟ හාරන්නට පිහිට වූ ඉතා කුඩා මිටිය( Rock Hammer), බයිබලය සමඟ සම්බන්ධ කර වටිනා දැක්මක් ඉදිරිපත් කළ  සුවිශේෂී අවස්ථාවක්.  
මේ මිටියෙන් බිත්ති හාරා එළියට යන්නට නම් අවුරුදු 600ක් ගතවෙන බව චිත්‍රපටය තුළම කියවෙනවා. ඒත්, ඇන්ඩි බලාපොරොත්තුව අතනොහැර සියල්ලන්ට රහසේ වසර 20ක් වැනි කෙටි කාලයක් තුළ එය ජයග්‍රහණය කරනවා. එය තමා ළඟ සඟවා තබාගත්තේ ඔහුට පරිපාලක දුන් බයිබලයේ පිටු මැදින් ඒ හැඩයට කපා සකස් කළ රහස් කුහරයක් තුළයි. ඇන්ඩි පැන ගිය පසු, දූෂිත පාලක නොර්ටන්ට මෙම බයිබලය හමු වන අතර, එහි මුල් පිටුවේ ඇන්ඩි ලියා තිබෙනවා, "Warden, you were right. Salvation lies within." (පාලකතුමනි, ඔබ නිවැරදියි. ගැලවීම තියෙන්නේ මෙන්න මේ තුළයි). තමා සැමවිටම අකිශයෝකිතියෙන් ප්‍රවර්ධනය කළ බයිබලය ඇතුළේම තමාගේ විනාශය සැඟවී තිබූ බව දකින නොර්ටන් සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම අන්දමන්ද වෙන විදිහ සිලමාවේ පෙර නොවූ විරූ වෙනස් ම තත්වයකින් මෙහි ගේනවා.

###################################

ඇන්ඩි සිරගෙයින් පැන යන්නට පෙර රෙඩ්ට පවසන්නේ නිදහස් වූ දවසක "බක්ස්ටන්" (Buxton) ප්‍රදේශයේ තියෙන විශාල ඕක් ගසක් (Oak Tree) සහ කළු පැහැති ගිනිකඳු ගලක් (Black Volcanic Rock) තිබෙන ස්ථානය හොයාගෙන ලෙසයි. වසර කිහිපයකට පසු සිරගෙයින් නිදහස් වන රෙඩ්, පොරොන්දු වූ ලෙස ම එම ස්ථානය හොයා යනවා. එහිදී එම ගල යට සඟවා තිබූ ඇන්ඩිගේ ලියුම සහ මුදල් හොයාගන්නවා. එහි ඇන්ඩි ලියා තිබුණේ සිනමා ඉතිහාසයේ අමරණීය වූ එකක් යැයි විදාරකයෝ කියන, මේ වැකියයි.
"Remember Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things, and no good thing ever dies." (මතක තියාගන්ඩ රෙඩ්, බලාපොරොත්තුව කියන්නේ හොඳ දෙයක්, සමහරවිට ලෝකේ තියෙන හොඳම දේ. කිසිම හොඳ දෙයක් කවදාවත් මියයන්නේ නැහැ).

මෙම ලිපියේ අදහස හා සංකේතයත් චිත්‍රපටයේ මූලික තේමාව වන උපායශීලී බුද්ධිය, ඉවසීම සහ නොබිඳෙන බලාපොරොත්තුව උපරිමයෙන්ම කියාපාන බව හොඳින් පැහැදිලියි.

රෙඩ් ද නිදහස් ව පිටතට පැමිණ Buxton පෙදෙසට ගිහිං ලිපිය හොයාගත් පසු වෙරළ තීරයක දී ඇන්ඩිව හමුවන අවසන් දර්ශනය තුළ ඇති පුදුමාකාර සංවේදී අවසානය සම්මුඛ වීම කිසිඳු සමිප රූපයකින් (Clos-up) හෝ මධ්‍යම රූපයකින්( Medium Close-up) වත් නොපෙන්වා ඉතා දුර රූපයකින් පෙන්වනන්ට මෙහි අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයා තීරණය කර තිබෙනව⁣. අපට අනායාසයෙන් එන ප්‍රශ්නයට අප ම පිළිතුරු හොයාගත යුතුයි. හිරගෙදරින් බාහිරව ලෝකය ඉතා විශාලයි. එහි සීමා නැහැ. ඒ පුළුල් අවකාශය තුළ කෙසේ මේ දෙපළ ස්ථානගත වේද? යන්න තීරණ කිරීම ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාට භාර දීම මෙහි අභිප්‍රාය වෙන්නට ඇති ය, යන්න අපට අනුමානයෙන් කිව හැකියි.

සාදාකල් වටිනා සංකල්ප
#####################

The Shawshank Redemption කියන්නෙ, නිකම්ම අංක එක වුණ චිත්‍රපටයක් නෙමෙයි. විවාහ දිවියක වේවා, පවුලක වේවා, ආයතනයක හෝ රටක වේවා දිගින් දිගට ම හිරකර තබන ජීවිත වලට පූර්ණ නිදහස ලැබුණත් බොහෝ විට හිරවුණ මනසින් සැබෑ නිදහස කිසි සේත් භුක්ති විඳිය නොහැකි බව අපූරුවට පෙන්වන විශිෂ්ට නිර්මාණයක්. ඊට හොඳ ම උදාහරණය යට කී හිරගෙදර  පුස්තකාලයාධිපතිවරයා. ඔහු වසර 50කින් ලැබූ නිදහස භුක්තීවිඳීමට නොහැකිව සහ බාහිර ලෝකයට හුරු වීමට නොහැකිව ගෙළ වැලලාගෙන මිය යාම අතිශය දාර්ශනික හා මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක කතාවක් කියනව. ඒ වගේ ම නිදහස, බලාපොරොත්තුව කිසි සේත් අත් නොහැර ඒ කරා යන ගමන දිරියෙන් යනහැටි ද අතිශය සිනමාත්මකව කියන චිත්‍රපටයක් තමයි මේ.

අවසන් වශයෙන්, මෙහි අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයා පවසන පරිදි සියල්ල තිරය මත පතිත කිරීම නොවෙයි, නිර්මාණයේ අවසානයෙන් පසුවත් දිගින් දිගටම ඒ පිළිබඳව සංවාදයක නිරතවීමට ප්‍රේක්ෂක මනස අවදි කිරීම සිනමාවේ කාර්යය බව කිව හැකියි.

A Film That Refused to Let Formulas Get in the Way of Its Story
##################################

I am opening with a thought inspired by something Tim Robbins—one of the two leads in The Shawshank Redemption—once shared in an interview.
Given the nature of its story, this film could have easily manipulated the audience's emotions to chase instant box-office numbers worldwide. Yet, director Frank Darabont revealed that he deliberately cut out even the most emotional scene performed by Morgan Freeman. Even though the acting was extraordinary, Darabont felt that keeping it would disrupt the authentic tone of the story. For anyone passionate about filmmaking, that restraint is a masterclass in itself.
So, how did this quiet masterpiece eventually bring immense hope to millions and change so many lives? And why?
To find the answers, I decided to look closely at the language of cinema itself. Here is what makes it unforgettable.

The Beauty of Hope Clashing with Institutionalization

We all know what it means to be locked behind physical bars for a long time. That part is obvious. What is far more tragic, however, is how we are forced to live inside invisible, mental prisons—trapped by social, cultural, and political walls that affect every single one of us.
Can we ever truly break free from them?
The Shawshank Redemption brilliantly captures how unrelenting hope, paired with quiet, patient determination over time, ultimately leads to triumphant freedom.

The Remarkable Thread of Friendship That Binds the Story

The plot centers around a banker sentenced to life in prison for a crime he didn’t commit.
Andy Dufresne (Tim Robbins) is thrown into the brutal Shawshank State Penitentiary after being falsely convicted of murdering his wife and her lover. Inside, he crosses paths with Red (Morgan Freeman), an inmate with a powerful network capable of smuggling almost anything from the outside world. A deep, unbreakable friendship forms between the two.
Using his financial expertise, Andy wins the trust of the corrupt guards and the warden by systematically managing their tax evasion and money-laundering schemes. Throughout 20 years of relentless suffering and oppression, Andy never lets go of his hope for freedom.
Then comes the twist no one saw coming. Andy pulls off a meticulous, breathtaking escape—and leaves behind a trail of irrefutable evidence that brings the corrupt prison officials straight to justice.

How The Shawshank Redemption Mastered the Language of Cinema

• Screenplay & Direction: Written and directed by Frank Darabont, the film uses Red’s voice-over narration to pull us deep into the soul of the prison. Combined with sharp dialogue that balances dry humor, pain, and philosophy, the storytelling radiates the warmth of Andy and Red’s bond.

• Cinematography: Veteran cinematographer Roger Deakins delivers unforgettable visual storytelling. He uses static, tightly enclosed frames to make the audience feel the claustrophobia and isolation of prison life. In stark contrast, the sweeping, wide-angle aerial shots during Andy’s escape amplify the sheer euphoria of freedom.

• Acting & Body Language: Tim Robbins’s quiet patience and Morgan Freeman’s grounded, seasoned presence are the heartbeat of the film. Their eyes and body language speak louder than words. Andy speaks calmly, yet his eyes burn with a clear, unshakable plan. Meanwhile, Red’s subtle reactions—his guarded posture and trembling fear when he suspects Andy might try to escape—reveal a man terrified to even dream of freedom.

• Lighting: Notice how cold, low-key grays and blues dominate the prison cells to evoke despair. Yet, whenever Andy is in the library or sharing cold beers with the inmates on the roof, warm, golden light floods the frame to symbolize humanity and hope. In the final scene, harsh, natural sunlight hits their faces—a subtle nod to both the rough reality they survived and the bright promise of Zihuatanejo, the free Pacific coast Andy dreamed of.

• Music & Score: Composer Thomas Newman breathes a distinct soul into the film. He uses slow, minimalist piano notes to mirror the heavy weight of prison life, building into soaring symphonic swells when freedom and relief finally arrive.

• Editing & Pacing: Editor Richard Francis-Bruce handles the passage of two decades seamlessly, using subtle dissolves and match cuts so the audience never feels fatigued. The film begins with a slow, deliberate tempo that mirrors the monotony of a life sentence, gradually accelerating until Andy’s escape brings the story to a thrilling, unforgettable climax.

Beyond the Sociological Tapestry into Psychological Depth

The sociology depicted in this film is extraordinary. A prison acts as a microcosm of society itself. The film vividly illustrates how inmates, isolated from the outside world, construct their own social hierarchy, rulebook, and subculture. The camaraderie and solidarity formed through characters like Red tell a unique story. The Shawshank Redemption beautifully portrays how, regardless of how harsh the environment is, human beings—as social animals—depend on mutual relationships.
While that stands on its own, the meaning delivered from a psychological aspect offers a completely different flavor. It is accurate to say that the film primarily explores the mental struggle between Hope and Institutionalization. When confined within the four walls of a prison for decades, people grow so accustomed to that environment that they even fear freedom. Take the character of Brooks, for example. Having spent 50 years in prison, he works with immense dedication as the head of the prison library. Trapped entirely within that internal world, he holds the firm belief that there is no hope for him on the outside. In contrast, Andy’s character demonstrates that with unshakeable mental stability and hope, one can rise above any confinement or collapse.

Through the Mask of Ideology to Classism and Politics

The way this film highlights and subtly satirizes ideology from religious and legal perspectives is brilliant. Warden Norton uses the "Bible" as his weapon, pretending to instill discipline in the inmates. In reality, he weaponizes ideology to mask the corruption and atrocities of his illegal businesses. Furthermore, the film shows that the law is not always just. Another core ideological trait here is that true justice and freedom must be achieved through rebellion against a broken system.
Exploiting this situation politically, the regime exercises its authoritarianism and corruption freely. Warden Norton cunningly masquerades as a devout religious man while abusing his political and administrative power. He orchestrates the exploitation of prisoners and even cold-blooded murder in the most inhumane ways. Through this, the film presents a sharp political critique of systemic injustice and the abuse of power.
Looking through the lens of classism, prison wardens and guards always view inmates as inferior, subhuman beings. Even though Andy is an educated, upper-class banker, he is initially subjected to the same brutal torture as any ordinary inmate. However, because his financial expertise (Cultural Capital) eventually allows him to attain a somewhat privileged status over other prisoners, the film subtly reveals how class power operates everywhere.

The Mozart Scene that Stirred the Audience's Soul

One of the most iconic moments in the film is the exquisitely beautiful scene where Mozart’s music is used with subtle precision. To briefly note its cinematic execution: Andy locks himself inside the warden's office and broadcasts Mozart's opera piece "Le Nozze di Figaro" over the prison's public address system. As Red narrates, even though the inmates do not understand the Italian lyrics, the sheer beauty of the music shatters the prison walls, bringing them a fleeting yet genuine sensation of true freedom. This bold act by Andy has sparked countless interpretations among film critics worldwide.

The Magnitude of Boundary-Breaking Dedication

During the climax, actor Tim Robbins (as Andy) had to crawl a massive distance through a sewage pipe overflowing with human waste to escape the prison compound. The unbearable stench and extreme discomfort made it the most unpleasant experience of his career. The most unfortunate part was finding out afterward that the thick, foul-colored liquid actually contained real cow manure and urine. Even though chemicals were added to sanitize it, he stated the odor remained intolerable. Because of this raw reality, the director noted that the scene achieved an extraordinary level of authenticity.

"Salvation Lies Within" – The Brilliance of Cinematic Irony

This marks the unforgettable moment where the tiny rock hammer Andy used to dig his escape tunnel is symbolically tied to the Bible. The film explicitly notes that digging out with such a small tool would take 600 years. Yet, without ever abandoning hope, Andy accomplishes the feat in secret in just under 20 years. He hid the hammer inside a hollowed-out section carved into the pages of the very Bible the Warden had given him. After Andy escapes, the corrupt Warden Norton discovers this Bible and finds a message written on the opening page: "Warden, you were right. Salvation lies within." Seeing the Warden completely bewildered upon realizing his downfall was hidden inside the very scripture he hypocritically preached is an unprecedented moment in cinema.

The Secret Location and the Letter that Brought Deeper Meaning

Before escaping, Andy tells Red that if he ever gets out, he should look for a large oak tree and a black volcanic rock in a hayfield near Buxton. Years later, upon being paroled, Red fulfills his promise and finds the spot. Beneath that rock, he uncovers a bundle of cash and a letter from Andy. Inside, Andy had written a line that critics hail as one of the most immortal quotes in film history:
"Remember Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things, and no good thing ever dies."
This symbol powerfully encapsulates the film’s core themes of strategic intellect, patience, and unbreakable hope.

The Cinematic Meaning of the Final Scene

In the final scene, when a freed Red travels via Buxton's guidance to meet Andy on the shores of Zihuatanejo, Mexico, the director makes a deliberate choice. Rather than capturing their emotional reunion with a close-up or medium close-up, it is filmed as an extreme long shot. We are left to find the answers to the questions that naturally arise. The world outside the prison walls is vast and boundless. We can infer that the director’s intention was to leave it up to the audience to decide how these two men will find their place within that wide-open space.

Timeless Concepts of an Unforgettable Masterpiece

The Shawshank Redemption is far more than just a top-rated movie. It is a masterpiece that brilliantly illustrates how lives kept in prolonged captivity—whether within a marriage, a family, an institution, or a country—often cannot truly enjoy freedom even when granted, if their minds remain imprisoned. 
At the same time, it cinematically portrays the courage required to journey toward freedom without ever letting go of hope.

Ultimately, as the director states, the role of cinema is not to lay everything out plainly on the screen, but to awaken the audience's mind to continue debating and reflecting long after the credits roll. 
The brilliant performances of leads Tim Robbins (Andy Dufresne) and Morgan Freeman (Red), Frank Darabont’s masterful direction, and Thomas Newman’s soul-stirring score breathe life into every frame. Truly, this is an eternal cinematic poem celebrating the human spirit's quest for freedom and the triumph of hope.

-Suranga Lakmal Senevirathne

items.text:
🎥 Give me all your best tips and tricks for self tapes!

❤️ Juni & Jazzy!

topComments.text: Keep it simple, good lighting (ring light), and having them do things that will show their personality! For instance, my son likes to “stomp like a dinosaur” and loves making animal noises. Asking him to do these things makes him warm up on camera and smile/giggle for the tape

Self-tapes are way simpler than they look, mama! Here's what works for us: film on your phone, horizontal, in front of a plain wall with good light from a window. Have your baby face the light, camera at eye level, and don't stress about perfect — casting just wants to see their personality! Do a quick slate (name + age), then the lines, and keep it short. Lincoln's first tapes were literally in our living room and he booked from them. You got this! 💛

topComments.text: She’s adorable! There’s lots of opportunities for her if you are wanting that!

My son started around that age too — start with just phone photos on a plain background, no need for professional headshots yet. Set up free profiles on Backstage and Casting Networks and self-submit to the little kid roles — that's how we got our first gigs before we ever had an agent. And please be careful of anyone asking for big money upfront to get started, that's a red flag. 💛

items.text:
Hi!
MODEL CALL – BERLIN!

I'm looking for a model for a creative, futuristic fashion photography project taking place in Berlin between December 20–29, 2026.

I'm working on a long-planned concept that I would love to bring to life at Schloßstraße U9 subway station, a location with a unique architectural atmosphere.

The project combines four different but interconnected futuristic fashion styles:

1. CLASSIC SPACE AGE

A retro-futuristic look inspired by the 1960s space age aesthetic.

- Silver jacket or jumpsuit

- Silver trousers or metallic bottoms

- Boots or knee-high boots

- Futuristic sunglasses with mirrored lenses

2. MINIMALIST FUTURIST

Clean shapes, geometric silhouettes and a monochromatic colour palette.

- Structured black or silver coat

- Wide-leg or straight-cut trousers

- High-neck top or asymmetrical design

- Angular sunglasses and minimalist boots

3. ORBITAL NOMAD

Technical fabrics, layered clothing and the appearance of a futuristic traveller.

- Silver bomber jacket or technical outerwear

- Black cargo trousers

- Chunky boots

- Utility belt, gloves, straps or technical bag

4. UNKNOWN ENTITY

A mysterious, otherworldly appearance with unusual silhouettes and distinctive accessories.

- Oversized silver, neon or other unconventional coat or cloak

- Fitted black base layer

- Full visor helmet or mirrored eyewear covering the face

- Long gloves and unconventional proportions

THE VISION

The goal is to create a cinematic, visually striking fashion series in which the model, styling and architecture become part of one coherent visual story.

I'm looking for someone who enjoys creative collaborations, is open to experimenting with unconventional styling and would love to be part of something a little different from a typical fashion shoot.

Collaboration: TFP (Time for Prints).

If you're interested, feel free to send me a private message with a few portfolio images and your availability between December 20–29.

You can check out my photography here:

https://www.instagram.com/rawrrrphotography/

Let's create something out of this world!

My name is Tamer a photographer based in Berlin and I’m currently looking to connect with other photographers, model agencies and creative art teams here in Berlin 

My work focuses in street photography, still photography, urban environment, landscape photography and street portraits with a strong focus on catching emotions and show them in an organic artistic way which define my photography style. 
I shoot with both analog and digital cameras
I’m especially interested in joining a team where I can shoot regularly and work with models or artists
I am also interested in doing photo walks here in Berlin with other photographers
I would love to help other people who would like to start learning more about photography in general and encourage them to go slowly into the world of photography
If you know any studio or agency or photographer or production company looking for a photographer, I’d love to hear from you guys
Here is my instagram if you would like to check my work 
Tamer_prime_84

items.text: 🎭Programme du mois de novembre !

sharedPost.text:
« Vivez, si m'en croyez, n'attendez à demain :
Cueillez dès aujourd'hui les roses de la vie. »

Pierre de Ronsard

Bonjour à toutes et à tous !

Un nouveau mois commence et, avec lui, de nouvelles occasions de se retrouver, de partager, de découvrir et surtout de passer de bons moments ensemble !

Nous vous avons préparé un joli programme de rendez-vous et d'activités pour mettre un peu de soleil dans les journées, faire de belles rencontres et vivre de chouettes moments ensemble.

Alors, sortez vos agendas, notez les dates et venez nous rejoindre !

N'hésitez pas à venir avec vos amis, vos proches ou simplement votre bonne humeur : tout le monde est le bienvenu !

On a hâte de vous retrouver et de partager ce mois de novembre avec vous.

À très bientôt et au plaisir de vous voir rencontrer !

Chaleureusement,

Ornella Bonventre

Info et réservation : tac.teatro@gmail.com  0614069223

18h – 19h30

COURS THÉÂTRE ADULTES
20h30 – 22h30

153, rue Danielle-Casanova, Aubervilliers

Là où l’art rencontre la thérapie

Des ateliers gratuits de création scénique pour libérer l’expression, dépasser ses blocages et vivre une expérience collective.

Un projet qui aboutira à une représentation le 18 juin.

153, rue Danielle-Casanova, Aubervilliers

_________

CLASSE THÉÂTRE INTERGÉNÉRATIONNELLE. VENDREDI 27: 18h

Un parcours intergénérationnel et pluridisciplinaire pour explorer les techniques du jeu et de l’expression scénique.

Un spectacle de fin d’année sera présenté le 19 juin.

153, rue Danielle-Casanova, Aubervilliers

You’ve learned how to act. Now learn how to make your work land.

Inspire is the finishing school for actors, the place where talented performers discover what has been missing and learn to work with greater truth, precision and impact.

Actors are taught to work for the camera. But what changes when the camera is actually there?

Join our Live Acting Masterclass and see The Inspire Technique in action through live before and after performances.

Witness what changes in the work, then hear Michael Keogh break down why it worked, and how the approach can elevate your self-tapes, auditions and performances on set.

Attend live and receive The Professional Actor’s Guide to Understanding the Film Lens, exclusively available to attendees.

Michael brings 25 years of acting experience alongside his work as an award winning director. 

His film ‘Underwater’ Won Best Global Short at the @savfilmfest and his screen credits include Peaky Blinders, Casualty and Marvel’s Secret Invasion to name a few.

Sunday 15 November | 6PM GMT · 1PM ET

Come along. Bring your curiosity. Let us prove it to you.

GET YOUR SPOT NOW:

https://go.inspireactors.com/free-masterclass

Please follow us before commenting so we can reach you by DM.

#actor #actress #actingclass #selftape #castingcall

Hello everyone, CASTING CALL!
I am an actor who is making my directorial debut with my very first short film this November. The film follows two brothers Noah and Caspian who work in an old whimsical book shop. One day a young woman walks in looking for a specific book only to be given another one that Noah and Caspian had previously agreed was too dangerous to share. 

Unfortunately this is an unpaid project with a small cast and crew. BUT travel expenses will be covered and food will be provided on set. 

Date - 17th November TBC (with potential of another day)

Time - 9:00 - 16:00 TBC

Location - Buxton

Noah - Male - 19-21

Noah is the older brother of Caspian. He is responsible most of the time and likes to have a plan in place for everything. When Caspian decides to think irrationally and put a girl's life in danger Noah loses his patients and all his hurt and frustration comes out in one.

Caspian - Male - 17-19

Caspian is the younger brother to Noah. He thinks more irrationally and doesn't think about consequences. His desperation takes over and he puts a girl's life in danger only having hope that his plan will work. 

If you are interested in applying please DM or comment with the subject line as Book Short Film - then the character you are applying for (I get too many emails to use my email address). Send your headshot, CV and showreel if you have one and I will then ask for a self tape. I can’t for your submissions! 

I am also looking for a runner on set as well so if you're interested in that please let me know. 

THANK YOU!

**ŚLĄSK...ZAGŁĘBIE...OKOLICE**

Na plan serialu Gliniarze Śląsk szukam:

**Dariusz Orlik (37) - **Niedawno zwolniony z więzienia po wyroku za przestępstwa seksualne. Nachalny wobec kobiet, fotografuje je z ukrycia. Podczas przesłuchania na przemian przestraszony i arogancki. 

**nagranie 27.11**

**stawka 700 zł**

**Marek Rosiak (58) - **Właściciel osiedlowego sklepu, ojciec Kamila. Rzeczowy, dobrze mówi o Martynie. Poruszony wiadomością o napaści, a następnie zaskoczony ucieczką syna przed policji

**prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 26.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Kamil Rosiak (32) - **syn właściciela sklepu. Sprawca napaści na Martynę. Na widok policji ucieka; podczas przesłuchania załamany, płacze i przyznaje się do czynu. Wymagana sprawność do krótkiego pościgu i zatrzymania. 

**nagranie 26 i 27.11**

**stawka 800 z za dzień**

**Łukasz Zatorski (21) - **Kolega Martyny ze studiów. Nie przyjmuje odmowy, śledzi ją i zbiera jej zdjęcia. Początkowo spokojny, kłamie o alibi; nagle ucieka. Po zatrzymaniu nerwowy i defensywny. Wymagana sprawność do krótkiej ucieczki i obalenia. 

**nagranie 23.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Matka Łukasza (45) - **Zwyczajna, zatroskana matka. Nieświadoma zachowania syna, odruchowo podważa jego alibi. Coraz bardziej zaskoczona, podczas jego ucieczki wpada w panikę. 

**nagranie 23.11**

**stawka 600 zł 1 scena**

**Komendant miejski (54) - **Doświadczony oficer, służbowy rozmówca Rychlika i Działaka. Rzeczowy, swobodny wobec Rychlika, mówi o organizacji zatrzymań i sytuacji innych jednostek. 

**nagranie 27.11**

**stawka 500 zł 1 scena**

**Grafik (35) - **Policyjny specjalista od portretów pamięciowych. Spokojny, cierpliwy i delikatny wobec pokrzywdzonej; 

**nagranie 24.11**

**stawka 400 zł 1 scena**

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na adres email **obsadaolga@gmail.com**

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie, demo lub link do wizytówki.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

sharedPost.text: Flexibler Musikerstammtisch. Gestern, nachdem das vereinbarte Lokal Portugal aus welchem Grund auch immer verschlossen war, sind wir kurzerhand ins Saigon Delhi am Ostbahnhof umgezogen. Und das hat uns sehr positiv überrascht. Sehr gutes Essen, davon vieles auch vegan, sehr sauber und absolut freundlicher Service. Wie immer, waren wir alle gut drauf und hatten einen schönen Abend. Vlnr.: Wolfgang Dokoupil jetzt bei Pias-kultradio.at, Gilbert Bishop Frontman Soulissimo, Arcel Grace (Christmas must be tonight), Lizel, dann ich, Andy Exmoderator RDB und Urgestein Inge Hirn-Socher Promoterin.

hello lovely people 👋

we're haystack, and we run fun, hosted dating events across the uk. think arcades, beer gardens, cookery classes, paint and sip and fairground games, with small groups of singles meeting new people over a few rounds in one evening.

we're looking for warm, friendly event reps to help host our nights, and we'd love to hear from actors and performers. we're hiring in all major uk cities, including london, manchester, birmingham, leeds, sheffield, liverpool, newcastle, nottingham, bristol, cardiff, edinburgh and glasgow.

what you'd be doing:

• welcoming guests, most of whom have come on their own, and helping them feel at home straight away

• running the games and keeping the atmosphere fun and relaxed

• helping groups move between rounds so the night flows nicely

the details:

• a few hours in the evening, at £13/hr.

• flexible, so it fits around auditions, rehearsals and other work

• no experience needed, just a friendly face and a love of people

if this sounds like you, drop dillan an email at dillan@haystack-dating.com with your name and city, and we'll have a chat 😊

and if you know someone who'd be brilliant at this, please tag them below!

sharedPost.text:
Hello, November! Branson's entertainment season is shifting into high gear!

If there's one thing Branson knows how to do, it's put on a SHOW!

And as we move into November, King's Castle Theatre is a wonderful place to experience the music, energy, and excitement that make Branson such a popular entertainment destination.

From legendary rock and roll to beautiful harmonies and patriotic performances, King's Castle Theatre offers a variety of productions for different musical tastes.

🎸 Anthems of Rock — Celebrate some of the greatest rock hits of all time!

🎶 Jersey Nights — Enjoy the unforgettable sounds of Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons.

🇺🇸 Spirit of America — A patriotic celebration of the music, history, and spirit of our great nation.

🇮🇪 Dublin's Irish Tenors & Celtic Ladies — Experience beautiful voices, Celtic favorites, and wonderful musical performances.

And with the holiday season arriving, it's a great time to explore the theatre's current performance schedule and seasonal entertainment.

Whether you're visiting Branson for the first time or you've been coming for years, there's nothing quite like the excitement of a live show!

👉 Check King's Castle Theatre's November lineup and make room for some wonderful entertainment during your Branson getaway!
https://www.kingscastletheatre.com/schedules/

Which kind of music is YOUR favorite—rock, oldies, patriotic favorites, or Celtic music?

items.text:
TIM BUSH

Age: 57
Height: 5’10”

PROFILE

A confident, versatile and experienced performer with a strong background in acting, live performance, presentation and entertainment. I have completed all available courses with Merseyside Acting & Drama (MAD), developing skills across acting, performance and character work.

Alongside my acting experience, I run my own YouTube channel, The Tim Bush Channel, where I present and produce automotive-focused content. This has given me extensive experience in front of the camera, including presenting, script development, interviewing, improvisation and communicating confidently with an audience.

I bring a broad range of practical and performance-based skills, together with a professional attitude, strong work ethic and the ability to adapt quickly to different environments and roles.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Acting & Presentation

● Completed all Merseyside Acting & Drama (MAD) acting and performance courses.

● Experienced in front of the camera through my own YouTube channel, The Tim Bush Channel.

● Confident presenter with experience delivering scripted and unscripted content.

● Comfortable working with different characters, situations and styles of performance.

● Strong improvisational and communication skills.

Martial Arts

● Former Martial Arts Instructor with approximately 20 years’ experience in Kung Fu.

● Achieved Black Sash level.

● Experienced in discipline, physical training, instruction and controlled movement.

● Retired from martial arts instruction but maintain the skills and discipline developed through many years of training.

Magic & Performance

● Member of The Magic Circle.

● Experienced in close-up magic, performance and audience interaction.

● Comfortable performing in front of both small and large audiences.

Music

● Experienced drummer and live musician.

● Currently play drums with local rock bands The Profile and The Live Jam.

● Experienced performing live in front of audiences and working as part of a band.

● Strong sense of timing, rhythm and stage awareness.

Automotive & Driving

● Highly experienced and skilled driver, including motorcycles.

● Over 20 years’ experience working within the luxury automotive industry.

● Extensive experience around high-performance and luxury vehicles, including vehicle testing and driving programmes throughout Europe.

● Experienced driving a wide variety of vehicles in demanding environments, including European roads and specialist test facilities.

● Strong knowledge and understanding of vehicle dynamics, performance and presentation.

PERSONAL QUALITIES

I am confident, approachable and professional, with a natural ability to communicate with people and engage an audience. My combination of acting, presenting, music, martial arts, magic and extensive automotive experience gives me a particularly diverse skill set.

I am comfortable working independently or as part of a team and enjoy taking on new challenges, learning new skills and bringing energy and personality to every performance.

Sent from my iPad

MAJESTIC TALENT AGENCY - BOOKS OPENING NEXT WEEK

We are excited to announce that we’re opening our talent roster to new applicants!

With some fantastic projects and casting opportunities coming through, we’re looking for dedicated performers to join Majestic Talent Agency.

*WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR*

- Child performers aged 8+
- Adult actors of all ages
- Strong Triple Threat Musical Theatre performers
- Actors specialising in Film & Television
- Performers with relevant experience or currently undertaking high-quality training

*PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING*

We’re seeking talented, committed performers who are ready for professional opportunities.

Previous professional credits are advantageous but not essential. However, relevant experience or ongoing training is required.

*HOW TO APPLY*

Email: newfaces@majestictalent.co.uk

Please include:

- Full name, age and location
- Height
- 1x headshot
- Training and performance experience
- Spotlight link, showreel or self-tape (if available)
- Parent/guardian contact details for under 18s

*Please note:* We are selective with representation, and applications do not guarantee acceptance, auditions or casting opportunities.

We look forward to discovering some exciting new talent!

*MAJESTIC TALENT AGENCY*
Where Talent, Dreams & Futures Begin.

#TalentAgency #CastingAgency #MajesticTalent #Actors #MusicalTheatre

Film Speed-Friending: Quick one-to-one chats with fun film questions. 🎬
Moved to Copenhagen recently, or just want to meet new people and make friends? Film Speed-Friending is one of the easiest way to do it.

How it works:

Have one-to-one conversation with someone new

Pick a film question card, like “What’s your favourite movie?” or “Which film sequel was better than the original?”

Chat for a few minutes, then meet the next person

By the end of the event you’ll have met everyone in the room and maybe found some new friends!

Love films? Want to meet new people? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Urban House Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone gets a chance to be part of a team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

sharedPost.text:
Another shoot day wrapped on No Gentle Goodnight! 🎬

The weather was kind to us yesterday, and we captured some absolutely stunning shots as the fog slowly lifted off the water to reveal the bridge. Couldn't have asked for a better backdrop!

Massive thanks to our hardworking crew from Sunny Runny Productions and Going Nowhere Productions. Another long day, another brilliant team effort, and some fantastic footage in the bag!

A huge thank you to our background stars, Beth & Georgie, Ronnie & Reggie and Dave Brewer, Curtis x, all making their screen debuts! 🌟 You were brilliant!

And a big shout out to our lead actor, Terence Caddick. A long, emotional day on set with some incredibly powerful scenes to bring to life.

There's a powerful story coming your way, and we're only just getting started.

Oh, and one last thing... PLEASE STOP CALLING THE POLICE! It's only a movie! 😂🎥

📸Reel Productions, The Studio.

CASTING CALL - Music Video- Independent production. (Female Pop Artist Re-Invention)
NO PAY roles for Actors, Actresses, Camera Operator and Gaffer seeking to add to their resume or experience. 
Music Video will be uploaded to YouTube/VEVO and promoted. ALL Credits will also be added in the Music Video description on YouTube. A signed release will be required for all actors/actresses.  Find roles below.

December 4, 2026
Refreshments will be provided. 
Some clothing items will be available to add to your outfit if needed. 

The video will take the form of a movie so actors will have lines. The scenes will be shot in 2-3 locations. Transportation will be provided between scenes if needed.
Wardrobe: Think the original Gossip Girl or The Devil wears Prada,  Upper Class Fall-Winter New York City - layers (2 outfit changes required, for pageant and the other scene). A plus if you have anything that can be worn as a pageant dress (short or long) (one scene is a pageant). I will add  outfit examples. 

Production for Camera Operator, Gaffer and Love Interest starts at 10:00am
Production for rest of cast starts 12pm but you’re welcome to come early to watch the music scenes being shot. 

Send Headshots, Reels or links to prdreamvalley@gmail.com if interested in any of the roles below.  If selected, you will receive an email with the script, location information and release form in the coming week. These are non paying roles for resume or experience. Equipment doesn’t have to be crazy. 

It will be a fun day while getting work done. 
 

Roles

Love interest (Male, African American) short speaking role. Handsome, athletic build. (Required to be shirtless in singing scene with artist otherwise clothed in movie scenes)

Heather Holmes - Antagonist (Female, Caucasian) spoilt rich girl, speaking role. Pageant contestant 

Layla (Female, African American) speaking role. Friendly, confident, becomes the lead’s friend. Pageant Contestant.

Stef (Female, all ethnicities welcome) speaking role. A bit ditzy but kind, becomes the lead’s friend. Pageant Contestant 

Farrah (Female, all ethnicities welcome). Speaking role. Perky/ecstatic. Pageant Contestant 

Heathers Protege #1 . (All ethnicities welcome) short speaking role, always in scenes with Heather. 

Heathers Protege #2. (All ethnicities welcome) short speaking role, always in scenes with Heather. 

Nick- (Male, Caucasian) Heather’s boyfriend, short speaking role, very cool. 

Nick’s best friend - (Male, all ethnicities welcome),a bit of a trouble maker, cool.

Presenter/ Host for pageant-  (Female, 50s, all ethnicities welcome) very short speaking role.  

Female holding crown and roses on stage (female, all ethnicities welcome) (Outfit required- formal dress, heels)

About 15 extras to fill seats in a pageant show audience (male/female, all ethnicities)- short speaking role (shouting) individuals will be zoomed in for scripted reactions (Outfit required- none specific) 

Production 

- [ ] Camera Operator 
- [ ] Gaffer 

Please only submit if you can make it as all roles are important to the production. 

Thank you for your submission.

**TITLE & TYPE:** Livestream – Mock Job Interview Scene
**CASTING:** Actor/Actress, 25+, to portray a professional job interviewer
**LOCATION:** Porter Ranch, Los Angeles, CA, USA
**COMPENSATION:** Paid – $100 flat for approximately 1 hour
**CONTACT:** bradmarschke@gmail.com
**TIME(s):** Wednesday, November 11, 2026 – ~3PM PST.

We're looking for someone to play the role of a job interviewer for a livestream production tomorrow in the Porter Ranch area.

You'll be conducting a mock job interview on camera. The role will involve asking interview questions, reacting naturally to responses, and improvising throughout the segment.

Looking for someone who can convincingly portray a professional interviewer, is comfortable on camera, and has strong improvisational skills.

**To apply:** Please email a brief introduction, headshot or recent photo, and any relevant acting experience. Must be available tomorrow for approximately one hour. Commenting below, and private messages on Facebook are also acceptable.

items.text:
Casting supporting characters for a SCI-FI short film!
Non-union, low budget, submit your headshot and reel via email : hypertensivefilms@gmail.com

Subject: [Role Name] - [Your Name]

Principal photography dates are January 9-10 of 2027, plus a few rehearsals before shooting. 📍Los Angeles, local actors only. 

Paid+credit+meal

Longline: At a high-end corporate agency that insures timeline alterations, a disillusioned analyst named Gettler who is haunted by the loss of his fiancé approves a grieving mother’s repetitive, fatal journeys to save her daughter—ultimately driving him to risk everything by traveling back to shatter the company's predatory illusion and finally face his own past.

ISAAC — Male, 40s–50s

Supporting

The charismatic yet morally compromised supervisor of the Temporal Travelers Agency, Isaac commands authority with effortless confidence and a quietly intimidating presence. Beneath his polished, pragmatic exterior lies a man who has learned to rationalize cruelty, concealing his own emotional wounds behind institutional indifference.

CLARA WATERS — Female, 30s–50s

Supporting

A grieving mother desperate to save her daughter, Clara becomes trapped in an increasingly devastating cycle of loss, obsession, and false hope. A deeply emotional role requiring extraordinary vulnerability, quiet desperation, and the ability to communicate profound grief through restrained, understated performance.

ALESSANDRO — Male, Early–Late 20s

Supporting

Gettler's estranged romantic partner, Alessandro is a sensitive, introspective young man whose enduring love is overshadowed by years of emotional neglect and disappointment. Tender yet emotionally resolute, he represents both the intimacy of a relationship slipping away and the painful acceptance that love alone cannot repair what has been broken.

Hello, everyone!
My name is Jay (she/they), and I’m a 38-year-old transgender woman with AuDHD. I’m starting a new theatre company in the Lower Mainland: A Stage Without Boxes Theatre Company.

Our company aims to put the stories and talents of transgender, genderqueer, non-binary, Two-Spirit, autistic, ADHD, and other neurodivergent artists, as well as people with intellectual, learning, and physical disabilities, in the spotlight.

As a new company, we’re looking for people to join our Board of Directors. We especially welcome interest from people who identify as queer or neurodivergent.

If you’re interested in helping build an inclusive theatre company and creating queer theatre, please get in touch. You can also follow us on Instagram at @A_Stage_Without_Boxes.

Hi everyone! I’m Cami 💛 I’m from Mexico, live in London, and work in editorial. People have always told me I have a nice voice so I thought I’d finally give voice acting a go :))

I’m a native Spanish speaker, fluent in English, and my voice is warm and conversational. I’d love to try anything from narration to bringing a little animated character to life.

If you’re casting for a paid voiceover gig or know someone who is, I’d love to hear from you! Happy to read a few lines for your project. 

P.S. I’m open to other creative projects too! If you’re casting a small acting role, putting together a photoshoot, or looking for someone to write with, I’d love to get involved. 

Link to a lil project: https://canva.link/the-female-experience-2

Jeszcze masz szansę dołączyć do naszej ekipy! 💚🎬

Przedłużamy nabór wolontariuszy BNP Paribas Warsaw SerialCon do 16 listopada! 📣

Chcesz zobaczyć, jak wygląda organizacja festiwalu od kulis, poznać ludzi z branży i zdobyć nowe doświadczenia? A może po prostu kochasz seriale i chcesz stać się częścią wyjątkowego wydarzenia? 🎥

To idealna okazja, żeby połączyć pasję z działaniem i razem z nami tworzyć kolejną edycję festiwalu!

📅 Na zgłoszenia czekamy do 16.11!

Nie zwlekaj, dołącz do naszej ekipy i przeżyj BNP Paribas Warsaw SerialCon od drugiej strony ekranu! 💚

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

3.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
